mapper.select: SELECT pay51_expense_form_id AS expense_form_id, pay51_form_cd AS form_code, f_cdnm('ExpenseDetailType', pay51_form_cd, pay51_company_id, f_today()) AS form_name, pay51_content AS content FROM pay51_expense_form INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'ExpenseDetailType' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn ,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= f_today() ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn ,'false') = 'false' ) ) ) sys ON sys09_code = pay51_form_cd WHERE pay51_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT sys09_code FROM sys09_code INNER JOIN sys08_code_kind ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = #{kindCode} AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_code NOT IN (SELECT pay51_form_cd FROM pay51_expense_form WHERE pay51_company_id = #{companyId}) ORDER BY sys09_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay51_expense_form ( pay51_expense_form_id, pay51_company_id, pay51_form_cd ) VALUES ( #{expenseFormId}, #{companyId}, #{formCode} )
